name: Wild Azeroot
tooltip:
Wild Azeroot
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
The hearty earthroot plant has grown stronger in recent years. Difficult to gather, but just as potent in crafting, azeroot is key to many recipes in Quel'Thalas.

This sturdy wooden herb can be found on or around trees in the Quel'Thalas region.

Zul'Aman -- a land rife with natural magic and ancient power. This power permeates all things in Zul'Aman, and has come to affect the herbs found within the region.

Gathering these wild herbs releases a burst of nature magic, giving rise to a group of hostile herb lashers that attempt to take vengeance!

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
